outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a standalone strict SIDE elevation concept of the SAME priest mitre in the two provided images, for Tripo multi-view 3D reconstruction.
Reference 1 is the exact FRONT of the hat. Reference 2 is its exact BACK. Create one true right-side profile, turned precisely 90 degrees from reference 1, with the wearer facing image LEFT (front of hat on image left; back and hanging cloth on image right). No wearer present. Match the same physical object, materials, ornament scale, panel height, brow-band height and lappet length. Do not draw another front or rear view or a three-quarter view.
CRITICAL CONSTRUCTION: this is a hollow wearable traditional mitre with TWO separate stiff pointed textile panels, one at the forehead and one at the rear, each with the gold pointed arch border from the references. The front and rear pointed peaks are at the SAME height and separated front-to-back above an oval head-sized opening. In side profile BOTH peaks are clearly readable, one toward image left and one toward image right, with a recessed folded ivory cloth side gusset joining the panels lower down, creating the characteristic deep V-shaped dip between the two peaks. There is real head-sized depth between the front and back panels. It must NOT be a single flat cardboard shape, a cone, a wizard hat, a single triangular slab or two separate disconnected hats. Continuous embossed antique-gold oval brow band around the entire lower circumference, with the same shallow curling foliage pattern. Front and back panel thickness is modest, stiffened textile edged with gold embroidery, not thick metal armor.
The ruby sunburst is on the outward FRONT-facing surface only (left edge in this view), so show at most its physically correct shallow edge projection; NEVER move it onto the broad side gusset. The three blue gems remain on the FRONT arc of the lower band only: at most a foreshortened edge glimpse of the near lateral front stone, no new side jewel or side medallion. The rear panel has no gems.
Exactly two long gold embroidered cloth lappets attach under the REAR portion of the band at image right and hang down freely, same width, length, flared flat ends and border pattern as the references. Since this is a true side view they substantially overlap; the far one may show only a narrow offset edge. Do NOT move one ribbon to the forehead or split them to front and back. There is no veil or fabric stretched across the empty space below the headband. Preserve the empty underside head opening with a narrow believable shadow at its rim, no head, hair, neck, face, bust, mannequin or support.
Composition: one complete isolated hat, upright as worn, strict orthographic SIDE elevation, no perspective exaggeration, full silhouette and lappet ends visible, centered on square canvas with white margins, same total vertical size as references.
Rendering: realistic fantasy equipment concept art matching the references, ivory woven cloth, antique warm gold embroidered borders and lappets, even soft neutral studio lighting, clear physical construction. Solid clean WHITE background without floor shadow. No annotations, labels, lettering, arrows, dimensions, frame, inset, collage, extra objects or watermark.

review.front: White pointed mitre with gold border, ruby sunburst and three blue brow stones; isolated without wearer.
review.back: Matching outline and lappets; plain rear panel and gold band without front jewels. Rear construction is inferred because original concept shows only the front.
review.remaining: Head opening, panel depth, lappet attachment and fit require confirmation in the generated 3D model; concept views are not measured orthographic drawings.
review.side: Two equal-height front/rear peaks, recessed ivory side gusset, continuous gold brow band and two overlapping lappets attached at the rear. Front faces image left; front ornaments remain on the curved front portion. Side depth is inferred from the existing front and back concepts.
